objective: Continue from the accepted R1 model-mask checkpoint and complete a failure-driven, parent-preserving iterative SFT tree without regressing the incumbent.

contract.intervention: At every MLP down_proj input, multiply every unselected channel by zero on every forward; no donor activations; attention, embeddings, norms, residuals, and selected channels remain live.
contract.recovery: masked_correct / dense_correct on the same records and same repaired model
contract.terminal_holdout_policy: Keep the terminal holdout unopened until the tree reaches round 8 or exhausts every predeclared repair branch at a depth. Freeze the incumbent before one terminal evaluation of R0, R1, and the winner on all 2,000 pairs in compact and spaced formats.

selection.candidate_space: For each repaired branch, evaluate the unchanged parent, parent-only shrink, and bounded score-ranked swaps that retain 99.5%, 99%, 97.5%, or 95% of the candidate budget from the parent. Global top-k is diagnostic only.
selection.acceptance: A child must pass calibration and development recovery/class gates. At the parent budget it must also improve masked development correct by at least one. A smaller passing child is a valid size-quality frontier improvement.
selection.winner_order: smallest budget, then highest development masked correct, highest calibration masked correct, highest parent retention, lowest branch index
selection.exhaustion: If no eligible child from any of the three failure-driven repair branches passes at a depth, retain the incumbent unchanged, record the exhausted depth, and continue fresh failure-diversified repair branches at every remaining depth through R8.

artifacts.teardown: Only after immutable upload listing and local/remote SHA-256 verification.
